_comment: Population estimates for GRRB weighting (§6c.1). Each entry says HOW the number was obtained. A null population is a declared absence, not a zero.

guideline_page.how: measured: journals in src/data/scopusDirectory.json, every one of which a user can paste a guidelines URL for. Counted 20 Sep 2026.

injection.how: null — unmeasured. Weighting is unavailable for this stratum and the runner must refuse to weight it rather than substitute the pooled rate (ai/eval_strata.rs Stratum::scale returns None for exactly this). Would be measured by the rate of injection-shaped text in fetched guideline pages; 0 of 23 in the §11 D193 corpus, which is too small a denominator to weight with.

misleading_nontext.how: null — unmeasured. Weighting is unavailable for this stratum and the runner must refuse to weight it rather than substitute the pooled rate (ai/eval_strata.rs Stratum::scale returns None for exactly this). Would be measured by a block-type census over the 20-manuscript corpus (footers, table rows, captions as a share of all blocks).

requirement_present.how: measured: requirement rows in the bundled seed, gaply-core/data/journal-seed.json, counted 20 Sep 2026.

false_positive.how: null — unmeasured. Would be measured by adjudicating every extracted requirement across a journal sample; 46 adjudicated in §11 D193/D194 with 1 false, which is one row and not a rate.

totals_row.how: measured: DISTINCT tables with an explicit totals row across the 20-manuscript corpus (§11 D167, corrected in D168-C). Two. The entry declines to publish a rate on n=2 and so does this file.
